summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT). Built PyTorch training and evaluation pipelines and shipped model deployment to Linux-based NVIDIA Jetson robots, cutting YOLO inference from 56.7 ms to 10.9 ms (5.2x) with TensorRT. Built robot data collection and simulation data generation pipelines (LeRobot-structured multi-camera capture, ~5,000 auto-labeled CARLA frames) using Python, C++, CUDA and ROS 2.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% by fine-tuning DONUT on a custom medical billing dataset; built PyTorch preprocessing and training pipelines on the HuggingFace VisionEncoderDecoder API.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Curated and annotated a 1,133-image custom dataset and trained YOLOv8n to 83% mAP@50 on held-out validation; exported to ONNX and TFLite for mobile model deployment.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Developed a Python GUI (PyQt, Matplotlib) for real-time data acquisition; used GitLab version control and JupyterHub for collaborative data analysis.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Engineered a custom data pipeline for the BraTS 2020 MRI dataset (augmentation, batch-loading memory management for large 3D volumes); trained U-Net segmentation on VGG-16, VGG-19 and ResNet-50 backbones, evaluated on Dice and IoU.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end latency across a distributed pipeline: Flutter client, Flask-SocketIO edge server, Jetson+Arduino controller over WebSocket.

Deployed TensorRT-optimized YOLO on Linux-based NVIDIA Jetson for visual servoing: 5.2x speedup (56.7 to 10.9 ms, 17.6 to 92 FPS) vs eager PyTorch; integrated dual VL53L0X ToF sensors for contact-aware grasping.
Built a LeRobot-structured data collection pipeline with multiprocessing for multi-camera frame capture; resolved 11 hardware integration failures (servo brown-out, stale-frame capture).

projects.name: Autonomous Driving in CARLA
bullets: Built automated simulation data-generation pipelines in CARLA (semantic segmentation, raycast occlusion filtering) producing ~5,000 YOLO and ~3,000 UFLD training frames with zero manual annotation.
Trained YOLO11n (mAP50 ~0.85) and fine-tuned UFLD (ResNet-18); validated in Town02 with 30 vehicles, 10 pedestrians, zero collisions.

projects.name: CUDA Kernel Optimization for VGG16 Inference
bullets: Wrote custom CUDA C++ kernels (memory coalescing) replacing VGG16 TorchScript conv layers: 49.2 ms vs 77.5 ms CPU, ~35% faster than naive GPU.

projects.name: ROS-Based Robotic Arm (AL5B & UR5e)
bullets: Planned and executed collision-free pick-and-place trajectories on a physical UR5e via the UR ROS 2 driver, validated in MoveIt and RViz (ROS 2 Humble, ROS Noetic); AL5B repeatability <2mm over 10 trials.
